api_contracts.purpose: Authenticate and freshness-check a typed remote command before local policy evaluation.
api_contracts.mutation: Records nonce only after signature and time checks pass.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Fail closed on malformed expired future-issued overlong invalid-signature or replayed envelopes.

api_contracts.purpose: Route automatically allowed structured capabilities to bounded local executors.
api_contracts.mutation: Automatic dispatch is read-only in Phase 1; mutating or execution capabilities stop at approval-required.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Unknown and shell capabilities deny; write patch process and clone return approval-required before side effects.

data_contracts.name: Workspace root
invariants: Filesystem operations are relative to os.Root and cannot resolve outside it through lexical or symlink traversal.
Process working directory is the trusted workspace root.

data_contracts.name: Process execution policy
legal_writes: Explicit executable allowlist and environment configuration
invariants: No shell string interpretation is used by ProcessRunner.
Timeout and captured stdout stderr are bounded.
Environment is explicit and is not implicitly inherited when configuration is empty.

data_contracts.name: Capability authorization
invariants: filesystem.read filesystem.list git.status and git.diff may auto-execute.
filesystem.write filesystem.patch process.run and git.clone require trusted local approval.
shell.exec powershell.exec bash.exec and unknown capabilities deny by default.
Remote request payloads cannot self-assert trusted approval.

data_contracts.name: Active-process nonce replay cache
data_contracts.retention: Until command expiry or process exit
invariants: A deviceID+nonce pair is accepted at most once within one active process before expiry.
Restart-safe replay prevention is not yet implemented.

ui_surfaces.name: Chat client
ui_surfaces.backend_authority: Future authenticated relay plus local PC-agent policy result
actions: approve or deny privileged capability requests
forbidden_actions: represent an unverified runtime result as successful

runbook_steps.name: Run race tests
runbook_steps.expected: all Go packages pass without detected data races

runbook_steps.expected: agent builds on current runner OS
